skyscraper = a very tall modern building
ground floor = the floor of a building at street level
first floor = the floor above the ground floor (in British English)
lift = a machine that carries people between floors
stairs = a set of steps inside a building
landing = the area at the top of a set of stairs
front door = the main door into a house
back door = a door at the back of a house, often to the garden
doorbell = a button that makes a sound when a visitor arrives
letterbox = the slot in a door for post
roof = the covering on top of a building
garage = a building for keeping a car
garden = land by a house used for plants and sitting outside
lawn = an area of short grass in a garden
hedge = a line of bushes that forms a border
path = a narrow way to walk, for example through a garden
porch = a covered area at the entrance of a house
living room = the main room where a family sits and watches TV
dining room = a room used for eating meals
kitchen = the room where you cook
